title: Group Draw Not Yet Published by GAM3RS_X Prior to Finals Week
details: As of October 13, 2026, the specific group compositions (Group A vs Group B) and opening head-to-head fixtures have not been officially drawn/published by tournament organizer GAM3RS_X on HLTV or Liquipedia. Only the overall event dates (Oct 14-18, 2026) and 8-team qualified field are confirmed.
resolution: SUPERSEDED on Oct 9-12 2026: HLTV published groups and opening matchups (Group A: Falcons, NiP, 9z, Aurora; Group B: Legacy, PARIVISION, FURIA, BETBOOM). See IRREG-007/IRREG-008 and data/fixtures_verified.json. The 28-line pairwise coverage is retained for winners'/elimination/decider and playoff permutations.

title: Absence of Pre-Match Sportsbook Fixed Odds Feeds (No Hotspawn Indicator)
details: Traditional retail sportsbooks (e.g. Bet365, Pinnacle, Thunderpick) have not posted published fixed match lines prior to the official group draw. Furthermore, per user requirements, Hotspawn's pick'em lobby cannot be used as an indicator of match probability.
resolution: Updated Oct 13 2026: a secondary aggregator (FreeTips, Oct 11) published an outright table, but no complete match-winner price pair was verified on an official bookmaker site and the table's bookmaker attribution is blank/unverified (see IRREG-009). We therefore keep bookmaker match odds blank and originate our own derived lines from Valve VRS (see methodology). Hotspawn is never used as a probability indicator.

title: Venue Wording Discrepancy Across Official & Secondary Sources
details: Thunderpick's official press releases state the event takes place at 'BLAST Studios Malta'. Liquipedia lists the venue as 'BLAST Arena Studios' in Attard, Malta. HLTV's news release references 'BLAST Arena studio'.
resolution: Confirmed to refer to the exact same physical production studio complex in Attard, Malta operated by BLAST for international esports LAN tournaments.

title: PARIVISION Roster Transition: slaxejezzz Benched, HObbit Signed Permanently
details: Valve's October 5, 2026 VRS standings list slaxejezzz on the 5-man PARIVISION roster. However, on September 17, 2026, PARIVISION officially announced slaxejezzz was benched and placed on loan, while Major Champion HObbit was signed permanently to the active lineup.
resolution: Flagged and verified. HObbit is recorded as the active starting member for the TWC 2026 Malta Finals, while slaxejezzz is cataloged in the bench register. Core roster requirements under Section 2.10/3.7 of the TWC rulebook are fully met (FL1T, Jame, xiELO maintain the 3-player core).

title: Contradictory Qualification Slot Phrasing in Official Qualifier Portal
details: The official Thunderpick World Championship Global Qualifier web portal contained conflicting text, stating in one section 'Four teams will earn a slot at the Malta Finals' and in another 'the winner of the Global Qualifier earns a spot at the $1M Finals'.
resolution: Confirmed from final standings: exactly ONE spot was awarded to the qualifier winner. Virtus.pro swept HOTU 3-0 in the Grand Final on Sep 13, 2026 and secured the 8th and final spot at the Malta LAN alongside the 7 VRS invitees.

title: EU Series 1 Winner Name Discrepancy (VRSDelivery vs DragonClaw)
details: Hotspawn's news recap from May 31, 2026 reports 'VRSDelivery win Thunderpick World Championship European Series 1'. However, HLTV's prize ledger lists 'DragonClaw' as the first-place winner.
resolution: Liquipedia transfer records confirm VRSDelivery was officially acquired and rebranded as DragonClaw on May 30, 2026—one day prior to winning the tournament final. Neither team reached the Malta Finals as regional winners only advanced to the qualifier.

title: Virtus.pro withdrew; Ninjas in Pyjamas replaced them (previous site edition was stale)
details: HLTV (Oct 9 2026) reported Virtus.pro withdrew due to visa issues for Aleksandr 'AquaRS' Kovalev and health problems / temporary step-back for Dias 'F0R3VER' Kutubay; NiP replaced them as next eligible team from host region Europe (within 20 days of start). HLTV Oct 12 lists NiP, not Virtus.pro, in Group A.
resolution: Corrected Oct 13 2026 (session 8c3d79a6): Virtus.pro moved to data/withdrawn_team.json (with HLTV-corrected player names F0R3VER=Dias Kutubay, AquaRS=Aleksandr Kovalev, coach ProbLeM=Dmitriy Martinov); NiP added as finalist (Valve VRS Oct 5 #18, 1534 pts); all 28 pairwise + 8 outright lines regenerated. Older VP lines are superseded and must not be used for picks.

title: Group draw and opening fixtures now published (supersedes IRREG-001)
details: Group A: Falcons, Ninjas in Pyjamas, 9z, Aurora. Group B: Legacy, PARIVISION, FURIA, BETBOOM. Opening Oct 14: 9z vs Aurora (HLTV match 2399384), Falcons vs NiP (2399385), Legacy vs PARIVISION (2399386), FURIA vs BETBOOM (2399387). Format: two BO3 GSL groups, top 4 to single-elimination playoffs, BO5 grand final after 3rd-place decider.
resolution: Published on dashboard with HLTV match links in data/fixtures_verified.json. Clock times left blank/unverified (see IRREG-010) — only the date Oct 14 2026 is asserted.

title: No official bookmaker match lines verified; secondary outright table has no named bookmaker attribution
details: On Oct 13 2026 no complete TWC match-winner decimal price pair (both teams, same book, same market) was verified on an official bookmaker website. FreeTips (Oct 11 2026) published outright decimals (Falcons 2.40, Legacy 3.80, FURIA 4.40, Aurora 6.30, BetBoom 12.00, 9z 14.00, PARIVISION 15.00, NiP 25.00) without attributing the table to a single named bookmaker in the extracted text. Our originated outrights differ materially for outsiders (e.g. NiP originated 60.22 vs secondary 25.00; PARIVISION 77.02 vs 15.00) — model sensitivity, not an error to be silently reconciled. Parallel session ef111e02 preserved one Thunderpick Match Winner reference observation for a TWC opener (9z Team +280 / Aurora -455 American, observed 2026-10-13, provider timestamp null, cross-provider join/timezone unverified — docs/data/quotes.json, 'reference only'). It is not adopted here as a current verified price.
resolution: Bookmaker match odds left BLANK. Secondary outright snapshot stored separately in data/external_outrights_snapshot.json, clearly labelled secondary/unverified-attribution, shown only for comparison. Picks use originated derived lines only.

verification_sources.label: Thunderpick reference market (via docs/data/quotes.json, reference only)

title: Hotspawn lobby: reader fetch succeeded Oct 13, sandbox curl failed; clock-time timezone unverified
details: play.hotspawn.com/lobby fetched via page reader on Oct 13 2026 showed 86 CS2 fixtures in filters, 4 labelled Thunderpick World Championship 2026 (Hotspawn match IDs 1080176-1080179), Tier S, 7 points, x3 tier, x1.25 multiplier as displayed. Direct sandbox curl to the same URL and to raw.githubusercontent.com failed (TLS EOF / exit 35), consistent with prior session 1d4de836 — a sandbox egress failure, not evidence the site is down. HLTV/Hotspawn extracted clock times (04:30/07:00/09:30/12:00 on Oct 14) carry no confirmed timezone in extracted text, and a secondary source listed different EEST times, so clock times are blank.
resolution: Hotspawn used for fixture discovery only; its displayed community pick percentages were NOT copied into any probability and are not reproduced as odds. Opening fixtures assert date only, with links for manual timezone check. LoL tab was visible in lobby (CS2 list only was collected); full cross-sport list is not claimed.

title: Player-name corrections and blank role fields (NiP roles, xKacpersky spelling)
details: Corrected from HLTV listings Oct 13 2026: PARIVISION xiELO=Vladislav Lysov (previously Daniil Chernyavsky) and zweih=Ivan Gogin (previously Nikita Bobylev); withdrawn Virtus.pro F0R3VER/AquaRS/coach names corrected (see IRREG-007). NiP player roles are left blank (not in Valve standings; not asserted). xKacpersky surname shown as Gabara on HLTV structured data and Grabara on a secondary site — HLTV spelling used, flagged here.
resolution: Names corrected with HLTV links; NiP roles blank/unverified on Teams page. Other teams' real names/coaches retained from prior HLTV-team-page sourcing and were not all re-fetched line-by-line this session — treat that layer as needs review; handles/points/ranks for all 8 finalists WERE re-verified against Valve Oct 5 file this session.

title: Removed unverified calibration claim; synced static ratings to model output
details: Previous edition stated lines were 'calibrated against 15,800+ historical prediction market orderbooks (Polymarket/Kalshi)' and showed static effective ratings (e.g. Legacy 1956.0, BetBoom 1715.0) that do not match scripts/originate_lines.py output (Legacy 1916.5, BetBoom 1632.5). No prediction-market calibration exists in the code; momentum bonuses (+35 Falcons, +25 Legacy, +15 FURIA, +10 Aurora) are model assumptions, not verified facts.
resolution: Oct 13 2026: claim removed from methodology/README; index simulator and methodology table synced to exact script effective ratings; momentum disclosed as derived assumption. Originated probabilities are derived model outputs, never 'verified forecasts'.
